# Mirror Array MX-4

The Mirror Array MX-4 is a tripod-mounted array of angled mirrors and a
camera that counts birds on a colony without disturbing them. It is made by
[[velloria-optics]] and stored at [[kelmouth-site]].

## Calibration

The array is calibrated every six weeks against a printed target board.
